name: subagent-effort
description: Sets the reasoning effort of every native subagent call from Jev's rating of its task, leaving the model as it was, and keeps local records to compare efforts.

apiKey.title: Jev API key
apiKey.description: The key Jev rates subagent tasks with. When it is not set, JEV_API_KEY from the environment is used. Sent only to Jev in the Authorization header; leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.

caps.title: Effort caps per agent type
caps.description: The highest effort Jev may pick for an agent type, as type=effort pairs split by commas (efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh). Left empty: Explore=medium,web-fetch=medium,claude-code-guide=low,statusline-setup=low. none turns the caps off.
